name: Clickzetta
description: This Test Connection validates access to ClickZetta and basic metadata extraction of schemas, tables, and views.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that OpenMetadata can reach ClickZetta and authenticate with the configured credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to ClickZetta. Validate the host, workspace, virtual cluster, and credentials.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List all schemas available to the user.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch schemas. Validate that the user can list schemas.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: List tables from the configured schema or an available schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch tables. Validate that the user can list tables.

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List views from the configured schema or an available schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch views. Validate that the user can list views.
